title: It was never clear from any UI text whether picking up a watched item while an NPC is 'watching' (e.g. the headframe lantern at Ness's post) always counts as theft with a companion penalty, or only sometimes -- the consequence (Tamsin disapproves) only became visible after the fact, with no preview like the will-check DCs get.
